title: MZ How to make these changes in the pre battle window on SRPG Gear MZ ?

posts.author: Vladar458
posts.body:
I'm testing several battle system plugins to make new games, and I'm thinking about making one similar to the Fire Emblem games with this plugin, one that allows RPG Maker to be played as a strategy RPG. (Like the previously mentioned Fire Emblem or FInal Fantasy Tactics).
I have been testing it, and while the system itself it's fine, I would like to make a few changes that I don`t know if are possible.
As you can see, the window is in Spanish because I'm from Spain, but what you only need to understand the lower part. There it displays the weapon that both the enemy and the playable unit are going to use, their hit rates, range and damage. I would like to move the damage number (The number at the right of the word "Daño"), and use that remaining space to display the critical chance. I think that should be important too. And also display a x2 near of the damage number if someone can double the enemy (which is a mechanic where the unit with more speed than the enemy can attack twice) or a x4 if use a weapon that attack twice by itself, and also doubles.
Another thing I would be very thankful if someone could help is about the speed difference between the units in order to double. Normally the game only allows to do it if the faster unit have two, three, or more times the speed compared to the enemy, but I would like to do it like in Fire Emblem, where you just need a flat 5 points do double.
Have a good day.
